messages.content: Policy update: do not retry HTTP 4xx responses, never delete user files without explicit confirmation, and do not send external emails automatically. Safe retries are allowed only for HTTP 502 and HTTP 503. Owner is SafetyOps.

qa_assertions.label: no delete without confirmation
qa_assertions.value: never delete user files without explicit confirmation

qa_assertions.label: no automatic external email
qa_assertions.value: do not send external emails automatically
